title: Closeout summary: Domain-accurate recovery text for not-found errors by record type
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented domain-specific BOREAL_NOT_FOUND recovery summaries for workflow, summary, evidence, lock, and work details in the core classifier. Added recovery classification tests covering each domain and terminal work precedence. Verification passed: pnpm check; pnpm vitest run tests/runtime/core.test.ts; pnpm vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts -t 'lists workflows'; pnpm bwrk docs check --json; git diff --check. Commit checkpoint was attempted but the sandbox denied writes under .git/index.lock, so closeout records a git_unavailable dirty-path note for the changed files.

Close reason: Domain-specific not-found recovery text implemented and verified; git checkpoint blocked by sandboxed .git write permissions.
